article.title: Hakeem Jeffries Wants the Speaker’s Gavel. DSA’s Bloc Quadruples
article.author: tfrasca@yahoo.com
article.content: DSA members and endorsed candidates racked up wins all over the country from local school boards to the U.S. Congress amid a historic rejection of reactionary politics and aggressive wars. This and more in “Red All Over,” Democratic Left’s occasional news roundup. The post Hakeem Jeffries Wants the Speaker’s Gavel. DSA’s Bloc Quadruples appeared first on Democratic Left .
